description: An MTL's text -> material -> the path of its diffuse map (client.render.model.MtlParser.parse): map_Kd after a newmtl, the rest of the line trimmed, as written; materials with no map left out; in the order the materials first come. input.text; expected: {material: path}.

cases.note: a material with no map is left out

input.text:
newmtl glass
Kd 1 1 1
newmtl body
map_Kd body.png

cases.note: a map before any newmtl is dropped

input.text:
map_Kd lost.png
newmtl body
map_Kd body.png

cases.note: the path as written: ../, blanks inside
a second map replaces the first

input.text:
newmtl body
map_Kd a.png
map_Kd b.png

cases.note: a material named again keeps its place and takes the new map

input.text:
newmtl a
map_Kd a.png
newmtl b
map_Kd b.png
newmtl a
map_Kd c.png

cases.note: options before the path are part of it
map_Kd and a tab is no map line
newmtl naming nothing keeps the material before it
map_Ka and map_Bump aren't the diffuse map

input.text:
newmtl body
map_Ka a.png
map_Bump b.png
map_Kd d.png

# newmtl body
newmtl glass
map_Kd glass.png
